items.t: There is no rapid transit in Chilliwack: no SkyTrain, West Coast Express or SeaBus station is in the city. Route 66 Fraser Valley Express (BC Transit) runs Downtown Chilliwack to Lougheed Town Centre Station, the nearest rapid-transit station.
Nearest bus exchange: Downtown Exchange, Chilliwack.

Route 57 Broadway (BC Transit): Downtown Chilliwack to Cottonwood Mall via Yale Rd at Menzies St and Young Rd at Olds Dr.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: streets and boundaries

items.t: Chilliwack Proper South is the southern part of Chilliwack Proper, the city's original townsite north of Sardis, in the City of Chilliwack; the City plans the whole district as one area in the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan, Schedule B-2 of Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw 2025, No. 5500.

The City plan divides Chilliwack Proper into four sub-areas — Mountainview (east of downtown), Riverside (north of downtown), Townsend (west of downtown) and Fairfield Island — and defines the planning area as the land around the Downtown plan area, bounded by First Nations land to the west and the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) to the north and east.

The working streets of the southern Proper are Yale Road, Young Road, Hodgins Avenue and Bernard Avenue, with Highway 1 along the south edge; the City plan names Hodgins Avenue and the Ashwell/Evans Road route as the area's strong links to downtown and to Highway 1.
A Canadian National railway line runs along the southern boundary of the plan area, and the City plan records that it reduces street connectivity and requires a 30-metre setback from residences.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is older detached houses on a townsite grid plus infill: the City plan notes several streets here were built as cul-de-sacs in the 1980s, which limits through-connections compared with the older grid streets.
Infill is the growth pattern the City plans for: the plan lists opportunities for infill development near Bernard Elementary School, Townsend Park and Chilliwack General Hospital, close to downtown.

The area's schools sit inside the neighbourhood: Bernard Elementary at 45465 Bernard Avenue and McCammon Traditional Elementary at 9601 Hamilton Street, both Kindergarten to Grade 5 in Chilliwack School District (SD33); Robertson Elementary is at 46106 Southlands Crescent.
Chilliwack Secondary School, the area's high school, is at 46363 Yale Road.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Most detached lots here are zoned R1-A (Urban Residential) under Chilliwack's Zoning Bylaw, and the City is actively rezoning individual R1-A lots — an April 2026 notice proposes 46510 Brooks Avenue from R1-A to R4 (Low Density Multi-Unit Residential) for a townhouse development.
Land use is set by the 2050 OCP, Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, and the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan (adopted May 2018, updated 2025) is its Schedule B-2 for this district.

New construction in the protected floodplain here must meet Chilliwack's Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519; city staff reports describe Yale Road properties in Chilliwack Proper as lying within the protected floodplain.

Development Permit Area No. 5 (Urban Corridor) applies on the Yale Road corridor: the City required a development permit for the supportive housing project at 45466 Yale Road because the property is in that area.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: There is a pedestrian tunnel at the foot of Edward Street that crosses under the railway to Meadowbrook Park and A.D. Rundle Middle School — the plan names it because the rail line otherwise cuts the southern Proper off from the Sardis side.
Chilliwack General Hospital is one of the anchors the City plan uses to justify infill here, alongside The Landing and Townsend Park.

From January 4, 2026, BC Transit shifted Route 57 service on Carleton Street one block east to McNaught Road, with new stops on McNaught Road and Acorn — bus stop locations in the Proper changed, so an old listing's "bus at the door" claim may be stale.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: development and new projects

items.t: 46510 Brooks Avenue — Chilliwack Proper; applicant Caleb Schier; rezoning application RZ001803 to change R1-A (Urban Residential) to R4 (Low Density Multi-Unit Residential) to facilitate a future townhouse development; home count not stated in the notice. Status: rezoning application at public notice stage, Council meeting April 7, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

45466 Yale Road — Chilliwack Proper, fronting Vedder Road and Yale Road; applicant Tasu Construction Ltd.; supportive housing development needing Development Permit DP001889 in Development Permit Area No. 5 (Urban Corridor) and Development Variance Permit DVP01483 to reduce landscaping requirements. Status: development permit and variance before Council February 11, 2025 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: costs and taxes

items.t: Chilliwack's 2025 residential tax rate was 4.50189 per $1,000 of assessed value all-in, of which the municipal total was 2.83455 per $1,000 — the City's own 2025 Property Class Tax Rates table breaks that municipal total into general government, services, culture and dyking components.
The City of Chilliwack publishes its approved tax rates by year on its Tax & Utility Rates page, and states that Council must adopt the tax bylaw each year before May 15.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: getting around

items.t: BC Transit runs Chilliwack's local system: Route 51 (Vedder) links Downtown to the UFV Chilliwack campus via Vedder Road, Route 52 (Evans) links Downtown to Cottonwood Mall via Evans Road, and Routes 53 (Fairfield), 57 (Broadway) and 58 (Tyson) serve the north-side streets.

Route 66 Fraser Valley Express is the regional link: the Fraser Valley Regional District states it connects Chilliwack and Abbotsford with Langley and Burnaby via Highway 1, and BC Transit expanded its Saturday and Sunday trips from Chilliwack in January 2026.
Chilliwack local transit fares in the January 2024 Rider's Guide were $2.00 adult single ride and $5.00 for a DayPASS, marked "subject to change" — check the current guide before relying on them.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: risks and due diligence

items.t: Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 is the key document: it designates the floodplains of the Fraser River, Chilliwack River, Vedder River and Vedder Canal as floodplain and sets Flood Construction Levels (FCL) on its Schedule A map.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Chilliwack Proper South
Between Yale Road and Highway 1, around Evans Road, Hocking Avenue and Southlands Crescent, Chilliwack Proper South is the established southern part of the Proper.
Chilliwack Proper South home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

46 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper South with a median price of $357,450 (the middle half sold between $295,000 and $418,725), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $398 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $363 a month. 44 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper South with a median price of $700,000 (the middle half sold between $619,750 and $771,250), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $392 per square foot, a median year built of 1979 and a median lot of 6,011 square feet.

faq.q: Which elementary school will my child attend?
faq.a: It depends on the exact street address, and three SD33 elementaries serve parts of the Proper: Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Avenue), McCammon Traditional Elementary (9601 Hamilton Street) and Robertson Elementary (46106 Southlands Crescent). Chilliwack School District assigns by catchment, so confirm the address in the district's school locator before removing subjects.

faq.q: Is this area in the floodplain?
faq.a: Parts of it are. The City's floodplain guide states that much of Chilliwack lies in the floodplain of the Fraser River, the Vedder River, the Sumas River or valley creeks, and Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 sets the building elevations for floodplain lots. Chilliwack Proper properties can sit inside the protected (diked) floodplain, which still carries flood construction levels.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or redevelop an older Proper lot?
faq.a: Sometimes — the City plan supports infill near downtown, and Council hears R1-A rezoning applications for exactly that, such as the 46510 Brooks Avenue application to move from R1-A to the R4 multi-unit zone for townhouses. Permission is lot-by-lot through rezoning or the zoning bylaw, not automatic, so check the specific lot with the Planning Department.

faq.q: How do I get downtown or to the highway without a car?
faq.a: BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder) runs the Yale Road–Vedder Road spine between Downtown Chilliwack and the University of the Fraser Valley (UFV) Chilliwack campus, and Route 66 Fraser Valley Express leaves the Downtown Exchange for Abbotsford, Langley and Lougheed Station. Route 52 (Evans) serves the Evans Road side toward Cottonwood Mall.

It is the south half of the city-proper side of Chilliwack — the downtown-side residential area working to Yale Road, Nowell Street, Spadina Avenue, Chilliwack Central Road and Young Road north of Highway 1; it is a board/search grouping, and no board-published boundary for it exists.

faq.q: Which schools serve Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: SD33 catchments are address-based. Schools named for the area are Robertson Elementary (46106 Southlands Cres), McCammon Elementary (9601 Hamilton St), Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Ave), Chilliwack Middle School (46354 Yale Rd) and Chilliwack Secondary (46363 Yale Rd), with names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file; run any specific address in SD33's School Locator to confirm its catchment.

faq.q: What did condos in Chilliwack Proper South sell for?
faq.a: The median condo sale in Chilliwack Proper South was $357,450, across 46 sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
